meta-muse.text: Muse presents a Meta personal agent for goals and tasks, including shopping, email and connected apps. Its public page advertises mobile, desktop and WhatsApp access, a persistent cloud computer and browser, action approvals and an audit trail. Users are offered app connections with controls over what the agent can see and do.

keyring-agent.text:
The KEYRING PRO wallet website presents KEYRING AGENT as a built-in AI assistant for researching markets, sending tokens and adding liquidity pools through a chat interface.

A separate server at keyring-agent.blockchhub.link publishes an OpenAPI description for wallet-action fee endpoints using x402 payments in USDC on Base. It names Bacoor as its contact and states that callers broadcast blockchain transactions themselves. An unpaid request to the add-pool endpoint returned an x402 payment challenge; paid execution was not tested.

The wallet website names Bacoor as its developer, but does not describe whether its AI assistant uses this API.
